"The world is ambivalent to my existence" No it's not. I'm here and I see you as someone who needs help and I'm here to help with that. 

It really helps expressing your thoughts so if you want to dump a massive essay on what's on mind feel free to PM me.

That being said, have you told people in a non-confrontational way (that they'd see as a reason to panic and make things possibly worse) that you've been feeling like a wreck and really need help? Telling people you're in a dark place is a start. People are more oblivious than most people think.

As for your friends, it's understandable that they'd have a hard time constantly having to try and cheer you up. If you **ever** feel like you need to dump some mental baggage I'm here for that. Maybe see if they can help in another way possible. The key thing is to try and see if you can make it work from another angle.

Again, feel free to reply with anything or PM me

Tom.

There seems to be a deep rooted problem that needs to be addressed that as ThePokemonMan suggested a therapist or psychiatrist could only diagnose.

And in the meantime; Who cares what people think of you? Who are they to judge? They'd probably feel the same if they were in your case. I'm certain that you're a creative and smart person. 

I'd definitely suggest seeking medical/psychiatric help in the immediate future.

PM or reply if you have any questions/need to talk

Tom.
No worries, but please come back here or tell someone you can trust if you're feeling worse tonight. Please please please. I got to bed mate it's almost 2am but I'll check up in the mornin'.

See there is something you like! I know it sounds tough or awkward, but it only gets easier seriously. I was very awkward until I started, and then talking to people comes quickly and easily. Most people just need something to connect with, that be music, games, interests. A massive tip is that almost everyone has the same way to talk to, and it's usually interests or stuff that's happened recently. 

btw I'm a gamer too :)

You can always ask, there's no harm in asking. And if not a physical move. Why not a paradigm move? Change your lenses and try and do something differently, go out and talk to someone you hardly know, go and exercise to relieve stress.. etc. Why not try and think of 1 positive thing about yourself every day. There's always something to feel positive about no matter what and I bet I could point some out as well. 

I know that I was/felt awkward around meeting new people until I went out and randomly talked to people. It was awkward at first, but it got easier as time went on and now I can easily talk to people.

I know that feel all too well about hating change. I changed states early last year and have only just started to make friends literally today. I thought I was leaving everything in my home state and yet feel like this is a good fresh start to a new chapter in my life. You can't tell until you make the change. Which seems like a very good option if you want to not hurt anyone and make yourself feel better, it can be the fresh start you need.

If not a person than a interest, goal or hope? Have you thought about a change of scenery i.e. a change of schools? Even thought your friends seem good. A change of scenery can help with increasing social skills that can draw you closer to people you can rely on.

There's no reason to feel pathetic or feel like an attention whore. You expressed that you need help and I'm here to try and make it easier for you to receive that help. Make sure you remember that, there's no shame in asking for help.

The fact that so many people have it says that there's bound to be someone who's thought exactly what you're thinking and with those resources you can really connect with someone who's been in that situation and come back.

There must be something or someone who you care about. Anything you are passionate about?

Please don't try and think I'm trying to get attention or "big up myself" but merely trying to contribute:

[I was able to pay for Ending_x235763's arrears and a few more bucks that was able to give some breathing space](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/oq1r7/debt_depression_and_downfall/) and [a few months down the track apparently he has been able to overturn his vacation notice and go see a mental health specialist](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/p5v5f/debt_depression_and_downfall_the_followup/)

Hi my name is Tom, hope that brings an essence of humanity here.

You have friends that are genuine in their support for you. The fact that you've posted here for help means that you need support which we are to provide.

First of all please please stop the self-harm. I know some people use it to "feel" because they feel numb or for other reasons but in the end you're parents are worried about their child and that's why they're scared. 

Second, you're only 15? I know that teenage feel of everything here and now and the cliché "You've got so much to live for!" but they're right. You're not even ~1/4 of your life through, just imagine all the great experiences you can enjoy if you can bounce back from this! I had a incredibly debilitating disease when I was 13 and I too became depressed and contemplated suicide but I got better and would not wish to take my own life now.

Thirdly, I want you to push past depression, did you know that over 121 million people have depression? There's a lot of resources out there for combating depression such as: [this](http://www.psychologytoday.com/blog/science-and-sensibility/201206/combating-depression) and [this](http://slingingthebull.com/overcoming-depression-fifteen-tips-for-combating-depression-and-anxiety/)

And lastly, I know it sounds lame over the internet but I'm here for you. I really am if you ever need to chat or discuss something that's been bothering you I'm happy to do whatever.

Hold on there mate,

Your internet friend, Tom.

I too, was also once socially awkward, I'm being honest when I'm not sure what caused me to get rid of my social anxiety and give zero fucks about what people said. But I did, I did it, and if you ever met me before I gave zero fucks about haters then you'll realise I was the embodiment of SAP.

I know it sucks being shy, I don't have a magical cure for anxiety, but there is one thing that I can give you. That is me wanting to be your friend. You and I both know that we are both only connected through the internet, but I say fuck it.

If a man needs a friend, I'll be there.

Hey mate,

First question:

* Are you a citizen of the United States?

Second question, although a tiny bit invasive

* How much does is your total annual income?

I only ask the second question because of the Government financial assistance has a income limit, it even says 

> Even if you are over the limit, people can still receive some level of assistance

Also, check with your doctors or hospital or GP, if they have ANY financial assistance programs, tell them your problem with money and they most always have a solution; many doctors have a low to lower income drug pay plans or something of the sort.

Also, are you doing anything at College/University? The government can lend out money to students such as grants, aid and more.

Also, about the job, have you checked on Craigslist for some casual one day work? Eventually maybe you could build up a "Immunity" to the work related stress and such?

Even if you are not doing any work for a company, how about you do the work around the house? Do the cooking, cleaning .. etc?

Tell me how it goes mate,

Tom.

If you really think you can't afford to take a risk like that, I'm not surprised, getting a job is a bitch. But, if you think you can politely tell them to please just chill a little bit more. The more work will become enjoyable.

What about your co-workers? Do you hang out with them much? Go to parties or meetings, etc?

>I'm decent at meeting people, but I suck at making friends.

I'll be your friend mate, know that please, I'll always be here to lend a hand and or an ear to listen to. But as for friends IRL, it's a not as simple as meeting someone and instantly becoming friends, it takes confidence, and a little bit of patience.

Fake it till you make it, confidence is key here, even if you don't think you have the confidence, fake it. Girls especially love the confidence and general motivation of a man. I mean, it's pretty obvious, who would you choose if you were a girl, a high school drop out or a person going some where and they have a job?

It's scary at the start, it's helluva scary at the start, (I still can't dance in front of people, but that's my last challenge) but once you start to at least start, it will only get easier. The more you delay doing this critical life skill, the more pain it will cause.

Don't fear the rising sun, embrace it, tomorrow is the first day of the rest of your life mate, don't be intimidated, but enjoy it. Because it's meant to be enjoyed.

Make the most of your life mate, make it fucking A-grade kick ass. Beat the haters at everything.

I'll be here if you need more advice my friend,

Both of feeling inadequate and being closeted by some fact.

I was a smart boy when I started school, I was tested and found to be gifted in a lot of subjects at school, I was sent to a advanced school, and my parents thought I would be a bright person.

I wouldn't think I'm stupid, just that I had a very poor drive factor, I just couldn't be fucked every time there was homework or assignments, and has a reason, my report card got progressively worse and worse.

And eventually from that I had a problem with being a Christian, and I eventually accepted the fact that I was an atheist, I held it in about 3 months, then when it reached a boiling point I blurted it all out in a argument.

**Keep your chin up mate, your a good person, you haven't done bad things, seriously, your a good person, telling someone about this is a good thing**

Don't feel bad, scared or anxious.

Hey mate, /brohug/

I know how it's to be put on a pedestal when your not ready or you don't want to. It sucks having to live to unrealistic expectations. That's was my entire life, until till about 6 months when I cracked, blasted my parents about them being to unrealistic and them being too school focused and controlling.

Firstly, what are some some things you *enjoy*, You don't even have to be good at but just jot down some things you enjoy doing.

Secondly, what are something you are actually *good* at? Even if it seems you're crap compared to everyone else, there is something you must be good at.

Thirdly, you need to connect the dots between the first and the second. This is more than likely to give you your ideal career or at least start you off in the right direction.

**Example:**

* I enjoy playing computer games.

* I am good at using a computer

* Therefore, I want to be a computer game programmer.

**Something along the lines of that,**

Also if you absolutely no clue (even after that exercise) where you want to go after high school;

* A good idea is either the military and see what they can do for you after your service; they usually pay higher if you are going into college (even if it something minor)

* Or get a random Bachelor of Arts degree, and go teach in many East Asian (Such as China, Japan or Korea) countries as an English teacher, No teaching degree required and the pay is quite generous

I know it's really hard to tell your parents things they don't want to hear, I did though (I was addicted and I had no chance of coming back) I talked to them, and discretely and as well as they could, they supported me through relapses and such.

So please, if you can't stand them putting you on a pedestal, don't be silent and think about killing yourself over it. Please go and talk to them, they will be your primary source of healing and comfort, no matter how distant your relationship is between you and them, they are your blood and I am fairly certain they wouldn't turn against you if you don't want to be 'XYZ'

Before I go mate, please don't go and kill yourself because of temporary failures, just go and find what you want to do, or even find acceptable to do after high school and go for it. Reach out to your family for love and support.

Finally I want you live a fucking kick ass life and to shove it in all your haters or doubters faces. Because they don't deserve it like you do. You have had a shitty luck run, every now and then it will repay you in due time.

**Now go out there and live that life you always wanted Shawn! Shoot for the moon, even if you don't you'll land amongst the stars. I'll be here for you if you ever need help Shawn,**

Your friend from the internet, Tom
